name: CL EIA Inventory Reaction Profile
description: Crude oil (CL) 1-minute reaction to weekly EIA petroleum inventory reports released Wednesdays at 10:30 ET. Shows average absolute price move at +1, +5, +15, and +30 minutes after release. Uses Wednesday + 10:30 ET time proxy for EIA detection (~5% error from holiday shifts to Thursday).
source:
# CL EIA Inventory Report Reaction Profile
# Detects Wednesday 10:30 ET release via day+time proxy
# Measures absolute % move at +1, +5, +15, +30 min after release

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
ts = index().value

# --- EIA Release Detection ---
# EIA Petroleum Status Report: Wednesdays at 10:30 ET
is_wed = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Wednesday)().result
bar_tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
is_1030 = bar_tod.value == 630   # 10:30 ET = 10*60 + 30 = 630 minutes from midnight
is_eia_bar = is_wed and is_1030

# --- Forward Moves from Release Price ---
# % move at each horizon (close at t+N vs close at t)
move_1m  = ((close << 1) - close) / close
move_5m  = ((close << 5) - close) / close
move_15m = ((close << 15) - close) / close
move_30m = ((close << 30) - close) / close

# Absolute moves filtered to EIA bars only
abs_move_1m  = where(is_eia_bar, abs(move_1m))
abs_move_5m  = where(is_eia_bar, abs(move_5m))
abs_move_15m = where(is_eia_bar, abs(move_15m))
abs_move_30m = where(is_eia_bar, abs(move_30m))

# Signed moves for event markers
signed_move_30m = where(is_eia_bar, move_30m)

# Event count for summary
event_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(1.0 if is_eia_bar else 0.0)

# --- Output: Punchline Bar Chart ---
# Average absolute move at each horizon
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='How Much Does CL Move After EIA?',
    category='EIA Reaction',
    y_axis_label='Avg Absolute Move',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    x_axis_label='Minutes After Release',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    order=0,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 min', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+15 min', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30 min', color=Color.Violet)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(values=(abs_move_1m, abs_move_5m, abs_move_15m, abs_move_30m))

# --- Output: Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='EIA Reaction',
    order=1,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EIA Release Reaction Stats',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['N (Releases)', 'Median Abs Move', 'Mean Abs Move', 'Max Abs Move', 'Hit Rate (Up)'],
        col_headers=['+1 min', '+5 min', '+15 min', '+30 min'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(abs_move_1m, abs_move_5m, abs_move_15m, abs_move_30m,
  abs_move_1m, abs_move_5m, abs_move_15m, abs_move_30m,
  abs_move_1m, abs_move_5m, abs_move_15m, abs_move_30m,
  abs_move_1m, abs_move_5m, abs_move_15m, abs_move_30m,
  where(is_eia_bar, 1.0 if move_30m > 0 else 0.0), where(is_eia_bar, 1.0 if move_30m > 0 else 0.0), where(is_eia_bar, 1.0 if move_30m > 0 else 0.0), where(is_eia_bar, 1.0 if move_30m > 0 else 0.0))

# --- Output: Event Markers ---
# Capture the 30-min move magnitude and direction at each EIA release
eia_close = where(is_eia_bar, close)
eia_move_pct = where(is_eia_bar, move_30m * 100)
eia_direction = where(is_eia_bar, conditional_select(move_30m > 0, 'Up', move_30m < 0, 'Down', 'Flat'))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EIA Inventory Release',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='30m Move', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                       card_color_map={"Success": ["Up"], "Error": ["Down"]}),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(eia_move_pct, eia_direction, eia_close, is_eia_bar)
